tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the past.dev developer documentation (Memory API and MCP server) and get back matching pages with an excerpt. Lexical search over the full corpus.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one documentation page as Markdown. Get product and slug values from list_pages or search_docs.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every documentation page with its product, slug, title and URL.
